contracts.name: Typed Plan
contracts.rule: Motion plans MUST be typed provider-neutral planning artifacts and MUST NOT become native project or timeline authority.

contracts.name: Revision Binding
contracts.rule: Every plan MUST bind project_revision and timeline_revision; stale application MUST fail closed.

contracts.name: Command Bus Only
contracts.rule: Mutating editorial application MUST project through the existing FA3 Video Editor Command Bus and approval path.

contracts.name: Engine Intent Only
contracts.rule: A motion plan MAY express logical render needs but MUST NOT select or execute a physical engine/provider directly.

contracts.name: Native Project Preservation
contracts.rule: Native editable projects and source media MUST remain authoritative and preserved.

contracts.name: Digest Provenance
contracts.rule: Every plan MUST carry a canonical digest and source artifact provenance.
